# newreleases_rocketchat_webhooks (Data Source)

Lists Rocket.Chat webhooks configured in the account. Use their IDs in `newreleases_project.rocketchat_webhooks`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "newreleases_rocketchat_webhooks" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
